5 تبدّل It (a thing, M) became changed, or altered. (M, K.) ―
-b2- In the saying of the rájiz, “فَبُدِّلَتْ وَالدَّهْرُ ذُو تَبَدُّلِ
” the meaning is, ذو تَبْدِيل [i. e. the meaning of the whole is, And, or but, she was changed, or altered; for time has the property of changing, or altering]. (M.) ＝
-A2- See also 10, in three places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
